question:
Figures 1 and 2 are screenshots of the same mobile app screen taken from two consecutive builds of the app; they may differ slightly in compression noise everywhere. At most one UI element has actually changed between the builds (recolored, content shifted, or removed). The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] with values in [0, 1] (origin at the top-left corner). Which region contains the changed element?
(A) [0.5885, 0.0078, 0.7038, 0.1231]
(B) [0.7344, 0.0078, 0.8497, 0.1231]
(C) [0.0111, 0.0080, 0.1264, 0.1233]
(D) No UI element changed — the screenshots differ only in compression noise.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
